name: Factory
description: Spec-approved work becomes merged code: implementer → reviewer → merged, with a human merge column only when the epic asks for it.

steps.instructions: Implement this ticket as one reviewable pull request. Read the ticket, its spec and the repository conventions first; reproduce any demonstrated failure before fixing it. Run the check that covers the diff with a finite timeout. Link the PR to this ticket. Then move the ticket to in_review. Never merge and never review your own work. An external blocker moves the ticket to blocked with the reason.

Review the linked pull request at its exact head against the ticket's acceptance criteria and the repository standards. If this ticket or its parent carries manual-merge, move it to awaiting_merge for the human. Otherwise arm auto-merge (gh pr merge --auto --squash --delete-branch) and move it to done. On a blocking finding, comment the evidence and move it back to in_progress. Never review or merge your own work.
Merge the reviewed pull request when you are satisfied, then move this ticket to done. If it should change first, move it back to in_progress with the reason.
